summary: FBRX 2.5.1 Beta (Weft): a second and third AI that carry on when the model fails (and practise first), closing the local model safely, alerts with all-clears to webhooks and syslog, copy and paste in the device consoles, and fixes for the Local API on Linux.
notes: If the model fails (AI models): a second and third choice carry on with the same conversation when the model stops answering (out of credits, overloaded, down). An offline chat never falls back to a cloud model.
Each backup AI practises taking over once it is saved: it must pick up a task the first AI began and use FBRX's tools. AI models shows Ready to take over or Needs a look, with Test again.

Closing the local model: switching models, Stop and quitting wait until the old model is gone, a model still loading is stopped too, and one left behind is stopped before the next loads. The Closing window shows how far it got, with Stop it now, and what to try if it is stuck.
Linux: FBRX reaches the keyring that keeps your saved credentials even when another app or a terminal starts it, so the Local API starts; Settings → Local API says why when it does not.

AI apps: when an app cancels or stops waiting, FBRX stops the task it asked for, so the model is free again. Hermes Agent's setup can be brought over (persona, memories, skills, MCP servers), and AI coordination connects OpenAI Codex CLI.
Alerts: a problem is said once, then its all-clear when it is over; webhooks in the FBRX Alert format, signed, and syslog over UDP, TCP or TLS for a log server or SIEM (Alerts → Delivery).
Device consoles (FBRX Digger): copy and paste as in other terminals, and the console fits the window and scrolls its own lines.

server.summary: FBRX Server 1.4.6: alerts for the server and its roles by e-mail, a signed webhook or syslog, each problem said once and then its all-clear, and a Terminal tab that fits the window.
notes: Alerts (a new page in the console): what goes wrong on the server's drives, FBRX Gate, MiniDome and FBRX Time, going on now and recently.

Where alerts go (administrators): e-mail through your mail server, a webhook signed with FBRX-Signature, and syslog over UDP, TCP or TLS, each from the severity you choose; an all-clear goes wherever its alert went.
The Terminal tab fits the window and scrolls its own lines.
From 1.1: sudo fbrx-server update check, then sudo fbrx-server update commit.

digger.summary: FBRX Digger 1.3.1: copy and paste in the device consoles, consoles that fit the window, and the same edition as FBRX Endpoint during support.
notes: Device consoles: select and press Ctrl+C to copy; Ctrl+V, Ctrl+Shift+V, Shift+Insert or right-click to paste. The console fits the window and scrolls its own lines.
While FBRX Endpoint is in support mode, Digger runs at the same edition until support ends.
Digger raises only network alerts; the computer's own health alerts come from FBRX Endpoint.
